scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('encore.gen')) fs.mkdirSync('encore.gen'); const manifest='encore.gen/package.json'; if(!fs.existsSync(manifest)) fs.writeFileSync(manifest, JSON.stringify({name:'~encore',version:'0.0.0',type:'module',exports:{'./auth':'./auth/index.js','./clients':'./clients/index.js'}}));"
